text:
maya: Heads up — I found a customer with a negative provisional token balance after a streaming reconnect + fallback to tool call.
maya: Looks like the session resumed, then the client retried and we double-attributed a trailing truncated chunk as a new toolcall.
sam: ugh. which customer + example request? can you paste the trace id?
maya: trace=tr-9b3c, session=ss-42b
maya: repro steps: start streaming chat, midstream network error, client reconnects -> server routes to fallback path that emits a tool_call for rerank, client also resends last chunk. both get counted.
jordan: logs show two consumption events for the same suffix range: 1632-1799 and then 1632-1799 again, but with different route_ids. looks like we don't dedupe across route fallback when suffix overlap = full match.
liam: console shows provisional vs confirmed diverging — provisional credit went negative after auto-adjustment flip. customers will freak.
ops-bot: ALERT: provisional-billing-anomaly detected for acct=ACME-001 trace=tr-9b3c severity=medium
sam: quick mitigation: can we clamp provisional floor at 0 in the UI and mark as 'investigating'? that avoids showing negative balances while we fix ledger logic.
liam: UI clamp is easy but hides real state. prefer a flag to show "provisional pending investigation" and surface affected sessions.
jordan: long term fix: ledger coalescing needs to dedupe by (session_id, suffix_start, suffix_end, toolcall_id optional) and prefer the earliest confirmed attribution. also add a fallback-route tag so we can reconcile route switchover duplicates.
maya: agreed. we should also tag stream events with resume_reason and upstream_route so the reconcile job can group them.
sam: can we sketch a minimal server-side guard first? patch plan:
```diff
- emit_consumption(event)
+ if seen_consumption(session, suffix_range) { attach_duplicate_tag(); skip_emit(); } else { emit_consumption(event) }
```
sam: that prevents double emission in the hot path until we do full dedupe in the ledger.
jordan: watch out for races where toolcall and stream emit concurrently on different hosts. need a small idempotency key in shared redis: key=session:suffix -> claim_id with ttl 30s.
liam: I'll add a console filter for "provisional traces" and a detail view that links to the stream/route traces. UX: simple button "mark resolved" for ops.
maya: telem ask: add metrics for duplicate_emits, dedupe_skipped, provisional_negative_count. also add span tags: session_id, resume_reason, route_id, toolcall_kind.
ops-bot: CREATED ticket #PLAT-1348 by sam: "prevent double-attribution on stream fallback toolcall" assigned:jordan priority:P1
jordan: i'll prototype the redis idempotency + patch today and put a canary behind a flag.
maya: thanks — please post PR and I can test against ACME repro harness.
sam: follow-ups: postmortem if we find customer-facing impact. notify billing ops if confirmed charges changed.
liam: noted. I'll wire the UI change as feature-flagged as well.
maya: cool. I'll add the repro logs in the ticket and attach a small harness script.
maya: tl;dr: double-count from concurrent stream resume + fallback toolcall across routes -> short-term idempotency guard + console visibility + telemetry to follow up.
